sections.title: Introduction
body: Welcome to MPL & MC Engenharia.

We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting the personal information you share with us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your data when you visit our website or contact us.

sections.title: Information We Collect
body: We only collect personal information that you voluntarily provide when you contact us through:
Email
Phone call or message
This may include:
Your name
Your email address
Your phone number
Any other information you choose to share
We do not automatically collect personal data when you visit our website.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
body: The information you provide is used solely to:
Respond to your inquiries or service requests
Communicate with you regarding our engineering services
We do not sell, rent, or share your information with third parties for marketing purposes.

sections.title: Cookies and Language Preference
body: Our website does not use cookies for analytics, advertising, or tracking.
We only use a language preference setting (cookie or local storage) to remember your chosen website language.
This setting is used exclusively to enhance your browsing experience and does not collect personal data.

sections.title: Data Retention
body: Information sent to us by email or phone may be retained only as long as necessary to provide our services or comply with legal obligations.
We do not store any other personal data on our web servers.

sections.title: Third-Party Services
body: We do not use any external analytics, tracking, or advertising services.
Our website may include links to external websites; we are not responsible for their content or privacy practices.

sections.title: Your Rights
body: You have the right to:
Request access to the personal information you have provided
Ask us to correct or delete your personal data
To make such a request, please contact us at:
📧 geral@mpl-mc.pt

sections.title: Security
body: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information. However, please note that communication over the internet (including email) is never completely secure.

sections.title: Updates to This Policy
body: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. The most recent version will always be available on this page, with the “Last updated” date shown above.

sections.title: Contact
body: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your data, please contact us at:
📧 geral@mpl-mc.pt
